title: Special Delivery
subtitle: Henry keeps watch while Leo waits somewhere cozy.

levels.title: Squeak at the Door
levels.clue: Leo carried Henry's toy to the front door—just as someone unfamiliar arrived.

levels.title: A Box on the Mat
levels.clue: Clear matches beneath each parcel so it can travel safely down to the doormat.

levels.title: Knock, Knock!
levels.clue: The knock startles Leo. Henry gives a gentle bark from their cozy viewing spot.

levels.title: Bring It Inside
levels.clue: Make room below the boxes while Henry keeps watch by the door.

levels.title: The Cozy Viewing Spot
levels.clue: Henry shows Leo where they can watch without standing near the visitor.

levels.title: Another Delivery
levels.clue: More parcels wait outside. Clear beneath them and bring every one to the mat.

levels.title: Henry Stays Close
levels.clue: Henry settles beside Leo until the footsteps at the door sound less scary.

levels.title: Packages in the Hall
levels.clue: The hallway fills with boxes, but Henry knows exactly where each one belongs.

levels.title: The Visitor Leaves
levels.clue: The footsteps fade. Henry checks the familiar clues that mean everything is safe.

levels.title: Special Delivery
levels.clue: Bring in the last parcels, then Henry and Leo can share the toy by the sunny door.
